product.overview_zh: 最近 10 个产品类实习里，几乎每个都要求「用数据做产品判断」，并能独立写需求文档、推动跨团队上线。AI 产品方向越来越多（4/10 明确要求懂 LLM、Prompt、Agent 或 AI 评测）。SQL/Python 多为加分项，但腾讯广告、字节 AI 数据岗是硬性要求。
product.overview_en: Across the 10 latest product internships, almost every role expects data-driven product decisions plus the ability to write requirement docs and drive cross-team launches. AI product work is rising: 4/10 explicitly ask for LLM, prompting, agent or AI-evaluation know-how. SQL/Python are mostly a plus, but required at Tencent Ads and ByteDance AI Data.

data.overview_zh: 最近 10 个数据类实习（DA / BA / DS / 风控分析）几乎都要求 SQL + Python。明显的新趋势是 AI：7/10 提到 LLM、Prompt、RAG 或用 AI 做自动化分析。看板（Tableau/Power BI）、统计与实验分析、机器学习各约占一半。金融相关岗位（OCBC、KPMG、字节支付）还看重风控和反欺诈业务理解。注：腾讯有 3 个 JD 内容完全相同，已去重。
data.overview_en: Nearly all 10 latest data internships (DA / BA / DS / risk analytics) require SQL + Python. The big new theme is AI: 7/10 mention LLMs, prompting, RAG or AI-automated analysis. Dashboards (Tableau / Power BI), statistics and experimentation, and machine learning each show up in about half. Finance roles (OCBC, KPMG, ByteDance Payments) also value risk and fraud domain knowledge. Note: three Tencent postings had identical JDs and were de-duplicated.
